lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName},

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: I need to ask you something.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: Protecting people requires tremendous stamina.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: That's exactly why we can't let up on our training.
That's right?

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: That reminds me, I'm curious about your training routine.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: What kind of training lets you keep going to the surface without wearing yourself out?

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: It has to take an enormous amount of stamina.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: The fact that you can endure all of that with a human body is impressive.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: I train in all kinds of ways myself,

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: but I feel like learning your routine can help me become even stronger.
Me? Nothing special, really...
I just do 100 sit-ups, 200 push-ups, and 300 squats whenever I get the chance.
I just catch the girls when they come running over to hug me sometimes.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: Whenever you get the chance?

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: Protecting people really isn't easy,

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: but I won't give up.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: Thanks for the advice.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: I'll push myself even harder in training from now on.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: You mean Nikkes come running up to hug you...

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: And you're actually able to catch them?

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: For a human to handle the weight of a Nikke body...

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: That's impressive...

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: What kind of training would it take to pull that off?
I don't really train for it.
It was rough at first, but after a while, I got used to it.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: You're keeping your training routine a secret...?

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: Guess it's really classified, huh?
No, seriously. I've never had any special training.
Ark Ranger Black doesn't respond for a long while.
Black...?

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: I tried it, just like you suggested.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: As expected, it wasn't easy.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: I knew strength like this wouldn't come easily...

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: But if I can't overcome something like this, there's no way I can protect people.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: Anyway, thank you.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: I didn't expect you to share such a valuable training routine with me.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: I swear I'll save everyone someday and repay your kindness.
